title: Idempotent payment API under client retries (synthetic demo rubric, not validated)

criteria.description: Uses a client-supplied idempotency key stored with the request and its outcome, and returns the stored outcome when the request is retried.
Records the key and the payment effect atomically, in one transaction or behind a unique constraint, so concurrent retries cannot both succeed.
Handles the boundary with the external payment provider: the provider's own idempotency, an outbox, or reconciliation of unknown outcomes.
Covers duplicates in flight, timeouts with an unknown outcome, key expiry, and reuse of a key with a different request body.
Justifies the design with concrete failure scenarios rather than bare assertion.

references.title: IETF HTTPAPI draft: The Idempotency-Key HTTP Header Field
references.summary: A client sends a unique key with a non-idempotent request; the server stores the outcome and returns it for retries with the same key, and rejects reuse with a different payload.

references.title: Pattern: Transactional outbox
references.summary: A service writes the message it must send in the same database transaction as its state change, and a relay publishes it afterwards.
